name: Drevka Mango-Habanero Hard Drops
description: Small hex-shaped hard candies with a mango-forward shell that cracks open into a habanero-laced center carrying a mild synth-caffeine hit. Sold in paper tubes of twelve.
flavor_profile: Sweet mango dissolving into a slow, building habanero heat with a clean stimulant finish — no jitter, just clarity
cultural_context: Popular among night-shift workers and students pulling study sessions who want something lighter than stim-tabs. The paper tube is considered retro-chic in Tier 3 circles, and empty tubes are sometimes used as small organizers for pills, micro-SD chips, or BCI calibration seeds.
story_hooks: A corporate whistleblower has encoded a data package inside a modified Drevka tube — the player characters receive it disguised as a gift from a street contact who has since gone missing.

Drevka Flavor Works is a legitimate front for a small-scale stimulant distribution ring; the mild stim in the candy is a legal gray zone, but a new Meridian 88 narcotics ordinance threatens to criminalize the entire product line.

A Tier 3 teenager is selling Drevka drops to Tier 1 kids at a massive markup, claiming they're 'street-grade stim' — the ethical and social fallout draws attention from both a community organizer and a corporate compliance officer.
